RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel choosing him over you provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination. In structural engineering, all-male panels commonly reflect industry demographics rather than an overt bias. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional standing.

The difference in experience and the announcement's emphasis on "excellent client relationships" suggest the panel prioritized business development and commercial skills over technical tenure. Instead of questioning the panel's gender makeup, follow up politely on your request for written feedback, focusing strictly on how you can improve your candidacy against the specific leadership criteria.
